properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC signing secret for JWTs. Must decode to at least 32 bytes. Set via the JWT_SECRET environment variable.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Explicit origins allowed by CORS. Set via the CORS_ORIGINS environment variable.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary cloud name for image uploads. Blank disables uploads (501) while URL-based images keep working. Set via CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: Cloudinary API key. Set via CLOUDINARY_API_KEY.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: Cloudinary API secret. Set via CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum accepted upload size in bytes.
